d:
On October 14, 2026, the central government decided to sell its stake in IDBI Bank. Ever since, this decision has been met with questions. The opposition is alleging collusion between the government and business interests, while bank employees have announced a hunger strike in protest against the government's move. Amidst all this, opposition leader Rahul Gandhi has written a letter to the bank employees.
